sophie: FYI CI is failing on the embeddings+rerank eval suite for the quantized model run (2-bit). Huge NDCG drop compared to float baseline, started after the refactor yesterday.
sam: saw the alert. which job? link?
ci-bot: [eval-rerank-quantized] FAILED — job 4521 — logs: /ci/jobs/4521/logs
sophie: job 4521. quick snippet from the logs: `ndcg@10: 0.28 (baseline float 0.62)` — that's not a model quality regression magnitude, feels like a metric calc or ordering bug.
kevin: can you paste the metric implementation? I remember we changed the rerank runner to return (qid, scores, labels) and then had a small change in the scorer.
sophie: paste below. it's in eval/metrics/rerank.py
```
# compute ndcg for a single query
rank = np.argsort(scores)
rel = labels[rank]
dcg = np.sum((2**rel - 1) / np.log2(np.arange(1, len(rel)+1)))
ndcg = dcg / idcg
```
ravi: immediate red flag: argsort() without [::-1] gives ascending order (lowest score first). That would put negatives at top and screw NDCG. Also rank indexing to log2 starts at 1 which is fine but mixing ascending is the big issue.
maria: good catch. But note we changed earlier to return score already as logits where higher means better — if someone assumed descending earlier it would flip.
dmitri: there was also a subtle off-by-one in the log denominator in an earlier version: use np.log2(np.arange(2, len(rel)+2)) vs current. But the argsort direction is the main problem.
sophie: can we confirm with a minimal repro? I ran this locally on a tiny qid and the scores/labels ordering matches the bug.
kevin: local repro command to run: `python -m scripts/eval_runner --suite rerank --model text-modelX-2bit --k 10 --qid SAMPLE_QID`
sophie: output from repro:
```
QID: SAMPLE_QID
scores: [0.1, -0.2, 0.05]
labels: [1, 0, 1]
rank (argsort): [1, 2, 0]
rel: [0, 1, 1]
dcg computed: 1.26
idcg: 2.0
ndcg: 0.63
```
kevin: expected ndcg should be computed with top scores first: reorder = np.argsort(scores)[::-1]
Also suggest we use `np.argpartition` for top-k in big lists.
ravi: patch idea: change `rank = np.argsort(scores)[::-1]` and add unit test that constructs a tiny deterministic example where you know NDCG@k. Also assert seed determinism for sampling.
maria: I'll open the PR and add the test + run the quantized profile in CI matrix. PR will also add a guard to ensure we compute idcg from sorted labels descending so people can't accidentally feed already-sorted inputs and get different results.
sophie: beyond the bug, we should also add a CI job that compares quantized-run metrics to baseline with a threshold alert instead of absolute equality. Right now CI just runs and reports numbers, no regression guard.
sam: agree — add a smoke-check: ndcg_quantized >= ndcg_float - 0.05 for integration tests to catch big regressions. Keep it loose to avoid false positives for legitimately different models.
dmitri: dashboard note: in Grafana add a panel that shows per-suite ndcg@k for float vs quantized and a diff series; tag by model and quantization-profile. That will help future oncalls.
ci-bot: comment: queued job: runners/ndcg-smoke-matrix on-demand for quantized profiles.
maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/789 — fixes argsort direction, adds unit tests, adds smoke check to CI matrix, and a short README note about expected deviations for quantized runs.
kevin: diff lgtm, just one nit about using `np.argsort(-scores)` vs `[::-1]` for clarity.
maria: updated to `rank = np.argsort(-scores)` per review. CI matrix re-run kicked off.
ci-bot: CI passed — jobs 4530, 4531 (float/quantized smoke) ✓
sophie: verified ndcg@10 now: quantized 0.59 vs float 0.62 — within our tolerance. Thanks all.
sam: can we add a tiny benchmark to the PR that records latency delta for quantized vs float in the eval run? just to have one committed datapoint.
maria: added a small latency log to the runner. will follow up with a dashboard card.
dmitri: note for the future — add a lint rule to flag any metric implementation that uses argsort without explicit direction. Helps avoid silent flips.
sophie: agreed. closing this thread after PR merge. :tada:
ci-bot: PR merged: #789 — branch: fix/ndcg-argsort — deployed to test infra.
